person_note: The controlling narration is third person, centered chiefly on Will Robie. The strongest Goodreads passage repeatedly calls Robie he while reporting his private history and preferences, and the authorized opening independently sustains the same external narrating position. The isolated I passage q01853 may be direct inner monologue, but its local context and typography are missing; the forum discusses a different purported interior passage and cannot resolve this quote, so q01853 remains unclear rather than non-base. No credible source indicated sustained first- or second-person sections. Confidence is med because the only strong web evidence is opening-only and the forum is Tier D discovery material, while the Goodreads channel has one clearly sustained third-person passage. Audit: independent review retained THIRD, downgraded high to med, corrected the forum from Tier C/THIRD to Tier D/none, and removed the unsupported local attribution of q01853.
